name: Native MulMat Tensor Layout Probe
scope: Diagnostic only — no implementation, no new runs

tensor_probe_results.graph_result: clean — no crash across multiple invocations

key_findings.direct_mulmat_works: Direct ggml_mul_mat(W, cur) succeeds without any reshape/transpose/copy
key_findings.tensor_shape_correct: [K,M] = [2048, 11008] is the correct shape for ggml_mul_mat
key_findings.tensor_contiguous: W is perfectly contiguous with row-major memory layout
key_findings.no_transpose_flag: W->op = 0 (GGML_OP_NULL), not TRANSPOSE — ggml_mul_mat accepts it
key_findings.Phase_24R_misdiagnosis: Phase 24R crashed in reshape/4D approach, NOT because ggml_can_mul_mat fails on raw [K,M] tensors
key_findings.garbage_output_root_cause: ggml_mul_mat only computes 'up'. FFN downstream (silu + down matmul) uses model's native quantized down weights, producing garbage
key_findings.not_a_tensor_issue: The issue is FFN architecture, not tensor layout

mode_A_native.output: The capital of France is Paris. Paris is located in the north

mode_R_direct_mulmat.output: The capital of France is   the  ""a'' htt (GARBAGE)

recommended_next.reason: Direct ggml_mul_mat works but is insufficient — FFN requires full up+silu+down replacement
alternatives: Focus on correctness (make PRT produce correct output)
Performance optimization within custom op framework
Accept custom op overhead as cost of PRT architecture
